name: Simplified Research Ensemble
description: 3-model architecture for Human-Centric Explainable AI research

xgb.purpose: Best traditional ML model + SHAP explainability benchmark

rf.purpose: Confirms XGBoost findings across different algorithm family

gnn.purpose: Novel contribution - graph-based fraud patterns with attention

performance.note: Lower than 5-model ensemble but clearer research contribution

cnn.reason: Not ideal for tabular data, marginal research value

tabtransformer.reason: Similar to XGBoost, adds complexity without research value

lstm.reason: No sequential signal in dataset - validates data leakage fix

research_justification.trade_off: 5% accuracy loss (99% vs 94%) justified by unique network pattern explanations

author: Research MVP
